source: bsm: Black-76 closed form in validator code (tests/validation/test_phase6_independent.py::black76). sigma is the calibrated-Heston ATM implied vol taken as an input from report/figures/benchmark_references.csv; the implementation's bsm.price agrees to 0.0. heston_*: two independent methods agree. (A) Gil-Pelaez P1/P2 with the little-trap CF (Albrecher et al. 2007), scipy.integrate.quad on [0, inf), epsabs 1e-14, epsrel 1e-13, in validator code; this is the stored value. (B) the implementation's forward-centred COS, as written by scripts/run_benchmarks.py (field method_B_cos_impl). heston_fo ATM also matches Fang and Oosterlee (2008) Table 4, 5.785155450 (10 digits), to 1.6e-8.
conventions: price = DF E[(cp (F_T - K))^+], cp = +1 call, -1 put; inputs F, DF, T (ACT/365F years); Heston params [kappa, theta, xi, rho, v0] with dF = sqrt(v) F dW^F, dv = kappa(theta - v) dt + xi sqrt(v) dW^v, d<W^F, W^v> = rho dt
accuracy: max |A - B| = 7.36e-09 (heston_cal, F = 7678); use an absolute tolerance of 1e-6
